hint: Type or paste it. This link works once and expires at {time}.
empty: Enter the secret, or choose Don't share.
privacy: It is saved to your own Aquarium credentials. The agent only learns its name, never the value.
network: Aquarium could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
invalid: That could not be saved. Check the field and try again.
storedBody: You can close this page and go back to your chat. The agent will continue.
declinedBody: Nothing was saved. You can close this page and go back to your chat.
unusableBody: It may have expired or been used already. Ask the agent in your chat for a new link.
